title: Anna L NDE 5373
content: I lost my sensory connection with my surroundings. I felt as if my body were shrinking, losing each extremity one by one (fingers, hands and feet, arms, legs etc.), until my body was reduced to nothing and all that remained was my consciousness. At the beginning, I felt upset at losing my beautiful and precious body (this was the first time in my life that I thought of it as 'beautiful and precious.') I became aware that somehow Light itself was calling to me. Then I found myself submerged in something, which seemed like a warm and welcoming sea, black and dark, where there was no sound. I wondered why I saw no one else there. As I lifted my eyes, I found myself gazing at a Light, which shone from beyond the sea in which I was submerged. The Light resembled nothing I had ever seen, it was huge, and I would even say infinite. Like a sun above the sea, it gleamed with every color. I could feel its warmth. It seemed to have its own life, its own consciousness, and its own movement, and it seemed to be aware of me and to be communicating with me telepathically. I perceived the Light above the water as being part and parcel of 'my' Light (that is to say, myself). The surface of the water was like a wall, which 'separated' us from each other, although we were the same thing. Gazing at the Light, I was filled with energy, and my only thought was to reach it. I moved as fast as I could, but I collided with something – an elastic wall of water. I then started using all my strength to break through that wall of water. I wanted only to reach the Light. Nothing else had any meaning and I was thinking to myself, 'No stupid wall is going to stop me from reaching my Light!' At the same time, something was calling me back – someone was feeling fearful emotions. I didn't realize that these feelings were coming from me, from my own human feelings of attachment. The light informed me that, in fact, the fear and the attachment to the world were mine. I ignored those feelings and went on pressing against the wall of water so I could merge with the Light, which now appeared formless. I longed to enter its embrace and finally did so! In the communication that followed, I had the feeling that we were good friends, the Light and I, and that we had known each other always and been through many things together. The struggle with my human emotions ceased, everything was calm. I had a fleeting vision of minor but problematic conflicts, during which the Light taught me to avoid harming others. The light asked me to explore my current feelings. Was I afraid? Was I OK now? What things did I wish for? How was I feeling? In the end, I decided I was really happy to return to the Earth to make good the hurt that I had caused. As I decided this, I felt myself being called back here again. I did not resist. I felt a peaceful resignation, a kind of 'Damn it, these human limitations don't appeal much to me, but this is something I have to do'.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt sensory connection fade and body shrink/lose extremities until reduced to consciousness; initially upset at losing her 'beautiful and precious' body.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Submerged in a warm, welcoming, black/dark sea with no sound.

arrival.other_being_detail: A huge/infinite Light above the dark sea, seeming conscious and telepathically communicating; felt it was 'my Light' (part of self).

environment.environment_other_detail: Dark/black silent sea; surface like an elastic wall; Light like a sun above the sea, gleaming with every color, warm.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: To return to Earth 'to make good the hurt that I had caused.'

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Submerged in a dark sea; elastic wall of water separating her from the Light; telepathic dialogue; brief vision of conflicts and teaching about not harming others.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Separation into consciousness and dark-sea/void experience precedes and overlaps with Light encounter; boundary (water wall) occurs between self and Light; then merging with Light; then decision to return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Perceived body shrinking and losing extremities until only consciousness remained; boundary described as an elastic wall/surface of water separating her Light from the larger Light; merged by breaking through the water wall.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “No stupid wall is going to stop me from reaching my Light!” / “Damn it, these human limitations don't appeal much to me, but this is something I have to do”.
